name: Talisman of the Waking
summary: Its bearer never stays in stasis for long: every dawn calls it back.

face.name: Talisman of the Waking

effect.name: Effect
effect.text: Assign this card to an Auros Entity you control. At the start of your turn, if the assigned Entity is in Stasis, untap it.

face.flavor: It beats softly, like a second heart.
